affected_subject.reason: Identifies GTELaunchpadV2Pair, its _update fee accrual, and swap amountIn calculation.

trigger_or_action.reason: Two+ state-changing calls in same block (timeElapsed==0) accrue undistributed fee; next swap counts it as amountIn.

direct_effect.reason: Undistributed fee inflates amountIn, causing fee-on-fee over-deduction and LP value dilution.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Fee should be distributed on _update and computed only on true deposits; mitigation states expected behavior.

summary: Report identifies affected pair contract, same-block accrual trigger, inflated amountIn direct effect, and expected fee-distribution/true-deposit relation, sufficient to attempt formalization.
